title: 第13章 皇老第14章 秒杀
lines: 紫曜神域的天穹，已然彻底破碎。
混沌翻涌，法则哀鸣，如同末日降临的画卷。
君家老祖那枯槁的身影裹挟着终结一切般的混沌气息，焚天老祖周身焚世之焰将虚空灼烧出永恒的黑洞，裂天刀祖则化作一道无形无质、却又斩断万界的绝世刀芒！
三位真正跻身不朽境界的恐怖存在，此刻目标空前一致，他们要碾碎那百丈祭坛，断绝紫阳神复活的最后一线希望！
他们如同三颗毁灭的星辰，撕裂了紫族老祖竭力布下的紫气屏障，带着令整个南域都为之颤栗的杀意，悍然逼近祭坛核心！
“紫老儿，今日便是紫族除名之时！”
君家老祖的声音如同刮骨寒风，枯槁的手指再次点出，一道比之前更加凝练、更加寂灭的混沌指芒，无声射向祭坛顶端那团搏动的生命光霞！
“尔敢！
紫族老祖须发戟张，目眦欲裂！
他周身氤氲的紫气瞬间燃烧起来，如同沸腾的紫色神焰！
一股同样决绝、甚至带着自我毁灭气息的恐怖波动轰然爆发！
他竟要以燃烧自身本源、乃至引爆部分祖地根基为代价，发动玉石俱焚的终极一击，强行拖住三人！
下方，紫幽冥这位紫家家主，早已浑身浴血，气息萎靡到了极点，拄着一柄断裂的神剑，大口咳出带着内脏碎块的金色神血，眼睁睁看着那三道毁灭洪流降临，眼中是无尽的悲愤与绝望！
紫阳仙等核心族人更是面如死灰，在三位不朽级存在的绝对威压下，连一丝反抗的念头都难以升起。
就要完了吗？
紫族的千古基业，兄长复活的唯一希望，就要在今日……彻底葬送？
就在紫族老祖即将引爆本源，紫幽冥目眦欲裂，所有紫族子弟心头被无边绝望笼罩之际——
嗡！
祭坛之上，异变陡生！
那团包裹着紫阳神身影、剧烈搏动着的翠绿色生命光霞，中心处，毫无征兆地……荡漾开一圈涟漪。
这涟漪并非能量波动，而是一种……光的涟漪。
仿佛平静的水面投入了一颗石子，又似沉睡的宇宙睁开了它的眼眸。
紧接着，在那生命光霞的核心，一点无法用言语形容其璀璨、其纯净、其……高远的光点，骤然亮起！
那光点出现的瞬间，整个混乱、破碎、充斥着毁灭气息的紫曜神域核心，仿佛被按下了暂停键！
狂暴肆虐的能量乱流凝固了。
震耳欲聋的法则哀鸣消失了。
甚至连三位不朽级存在那毁天灭地的恐怖威压与攻势，都仿佛陷入了粘稠的琥珀之中，变得无比迟滞！
所有人的目光，无论敌我，无论修为高低，都被一股无形的、无法抗拒的力量所牵引，不由自主地、死死地钉在了祭坛顶端！
那一点璀璨的光点，如同宇宙诞生之初的第一缕光，迅速扩散、升腾！
无尽的光辉从中流淌而出，并非刺目，而是带着一种包容万象、抚慰灵魂的温润与浩瀚。
光芒交织、凝聚，最终化作了一道……巍峨的光影！
这光影并非实体，却比任何神山巨岳更加磅礴！
他静静地矗立在祭坛之巅，仿佛自亘古岁月之前便已存在于此，成为了这片天地的绝对中心与支柱！
其形态模糊不清，只能隐约看到一个人形的轮廓，通体由最纯粹、最本源的光芒构成，流淌着无法理解的玄奥道纹。
一种超越了时间、空间、超越了在场所有人认知范畴的……无上气息，如同沉睡的星海意志，缓缓弥漫开来。
在这股气息面前，君家老祖那混沌灭世的气息，焚天老祖那焚尽八荒的烈焰，裂天刀祖那斩断万道的锋芒……都显得如此渺小、如此……微不足道！
如同萤火之于皓月，尘埃之于星河！
紫幽冥布满血污的脸上，那极致的绝望瞬间被一种无法言喻的激动与狂喜所取代！
他身体剧烈颤抖，几乎要站立不稳，不是因为伤势，而是因为灵魂深处的震撼与崇敬！
“吾等……参见……皇老！
紫幽冥，连同身边的几位紫族核心长老，以及高天之上正欲引爆本源的紫族老祖，竟在第一时间，不顾自身重伤与强敌环伺，无比恭敬、无比虔诚地朝着那道巍峨光影……深深躬身行礼！
content_en:
The sky of Zi Yao Divine Realm has been completely shattered.
Chaos surges, and the laws wail, like a picture of the end of the world.
The withered figure of the ancestor of the Jun family was wrapped in the aura of chaos that would end everything. The flames of the burning world burned around the ancestor of the Burning Sky burned an eternal black hole in the void, and the ancestor of the Sky Splitting Sword turned into an invisible and peerless sword light that cut through all worlds!
The three terrifying beings who have truly reached the realm of immortality have the same goal as never before. They want to crush the Baizhang Altar and cut off the last glimmer of hope for the resurrection of the Purple Sun God!
Like three stars of destruction, they tore apart the purple energy barrier that the ancestors of the Purple Clan had put up with all their strength. With murderous intent that made the entire Southern Territory tremble, they brazenly approached the core of the altar!
"Old Zi, today is the day when the Zi clan will be expelled!"
The voice of the ancestor of the Jun family was like a bone-chilling wind, and his withered fingers pointed out again, a finger of chaos that was more condensed and dead than before, silently shooting towards the pulsating glow of life at the top of the altar!
"How dare you!
! "
The ancestor of the Purple Clan has his hair spread out and his eyes are about to burst!
The dense purple energy around him burned instantly, like a boiling purple divine flame!
An equally decisive and even self-destructive wave of terror erupted!
At the cost of burning his own origins and even detonating part of the foundation of his ancestral land, he launched the ultimate blow that would destroy both the stone and the stone and forcefully hold down the three of them!
Below, Zi Youming, the head of the Zi family, was already covered in blood, and his aura was extremely depressed. He was holding a broken divine sword and coughing up golden divine blood with fragments of internal organs. He watched the three torrents of destruction coming, with endless grief, anger and despair in his eyes!
Ziyangxian and other core tribesmen were even more ashen-faced. Under the absolute pressure of the three immortal-level beings, it was difficult for them to even have the slightest thought of resistance.
Is it almost over?
The purple clan's eternal legacy, the only hope for brother's resurrection, will be completely ruined today...?
Just when the ancestor of the Purple Clan was about to detonate his origin, Zi Youming's eyes were about to burst, and the hearts of all the Purple Clan disciples were shrouded in boundless despair——
Buzz!
On the altar, sudden changes occurred!
The intensely pulsing emerald-green glow of life wrapped around the figure of the Purple Sun God, without any warning... ripples appeared in the center.
This ripple is not an energy fluctuation, but a... ripple of light.
It's as if a stone has been dropped into the calm water, and it's like the sleeping universe has opened its eyes.
Immediately afterwards, at the core of the glow of life, a point of light that could not be described in words, its brilliance, its purity, its... high distance, suddenly lit up!
The moment the light spot appeared, the entire chaotic, broken, and destructive core of the Zi Yao Divine Realm seemed to have been pressed on the pause button!
The violent and raging energy flow solidified.
The deafening wail of the Law disappeared.
Even the terrifying pressure and offensive of the three immortal-level beings seemed to be trapped in sticky amber and became extremely sluggish!
Everyone's eyes, regardless of friend or foe, regardless of their level of cultivation, were drawn by an invisible and irresistible force, and were involuntarily and firmly nailed to the top of the altar!
That bright spot of light, like the first ray of light at the birth of the universe, rapidly spread and rose!
Endless brilliance flows from it, not dazzlingly, but with a kind of warmth and vastness that is inclusive of all things and soothes the soul.
The light intertwined and condensed, and finally turned into a... majestic light and shadow!
This light and shadow is not physical, but it is more majestic than any sacred mountain!
He stood quietly on top of the altar, as if he had existed here since eternity, becoming the absolute center and pillar of this world!
Its shape is blurry, and only the outline of a human figure can be vaguely seen. The entire body is composed of the purest and most original light, flowing with incomprehensible mysterious patterns.
A kind of supreme aura that transcends time, space, and beyond the cognitive scope of everyone present, is like the sleeping will of the sea of ​​stars, slowly spreading.
In front of this aura, the chaotic and world-destroying aura of the ancestor of the Jun family, the blazing flames of the ancestor Fentian, the sharp edge that cut through ten thousand paths... all seemed so small, so... insignificant!
Just as fireflies are to the bright moon, dust is to the stars!
"This...this is..."
On Zi Youming's blood-stained face, the extreme despair was instantly replaced by an indescribable excitement and ecstasy!
His body was shaking violently, almost unsteady on his feet, not because of his injuries, but because of the shock and reverence deep in his soul!
"We...see...Mr. Huang!
! "
Zi Youming, together with several core elders of the Purple Clan around him, as well as the ancestor of the Purple Clan who was about to detonate the origin in the sky, immediately, regardless of his own serious injuries and being surrounded by powerful enemies, bowed deeply towards that majestic light and shadow with great respect and piety...
title_en: Chapter 13 Mr. Huang Chapter 14 Instant Kill
